text:
Maya (PM): Quick sync — need to lock the cohort qualification + feedback cadence for the next private preview. I sketched an MVP scope and screening flow. Can we agree on criteria today?

Jon (GTM): I can consolidate outreach once criteria are final. We should prioritize customers who: low-latency needs, on-prem interest, and existing paid customers. Also need at least 2 partners with compliance constraints.

Priya (Eng): From an infra side, we can support up to 8 concurrent private clusters for the pilot. Recommend max 12 orgs total so we can pair them with tech leads for onboarding.

Theo (SE): +1 to pairing. Also suggest 1 sandbox org for early exploratory sessions (not counted towards the 12) so we can validate installs.

Maya (PM): Proposed screening rules (shortlist):
- Must be able to commit 4 weeks of product time (PO / eng or platform contact)
- One production use-case (or clear migration plan)
- Data sensitivity: 2 must require on-prem/VPC
- Diversity: mix of fintech, healthcare, and platform teams

Ana (Solutions): Recruiting tip: ask for a short video (2–3 mins) of their current workflow — screenshare of problem. Cuts down discovery calls.

Jon (GTM): Love the video ask. It will also surface the right customers for impact stories. I'll draft the outreach copy.

Maya (PM): Feedback cadence proposal: weekly 60-min sessions for the first 2 weeks, then biweekly check-ins for the remainder of the 8-week pilot. Deliverables: weekly red/yellow/green health check + prompt set evaluation.

Priya (Eng): Need to be explicit about entitlements: what telemetry we collect, and where logs live. For private preview we only ship aggregated latency/cost metrics and allow opt-out for token sampling.

Theo (SE): Also we should instrument a small eval harness customers can run (local CLI) to produce a baseline perf/quality report. Shipping command: ```bash
redwood-eval --suite cohort-baseline --output baseline.json
```

Maya (PM): Good — include that in onboarding checklist. Now scope negotiation: some prospects asked for model-edit (fine-tuning) + integrated eval dashboards. My recommendation: MVP = serving-only + prompt-level regression alerts + simple manual log export. Defer fine-tuning and integrated eval dashboards to post-launch. Thoughts?

Ana (Solutions): Agree. Fine-tuning is a big infra + compliance ask. We can surface it as "roadmap ask" but not promise.

Jon (GTM): Sales angle: offer an optional consulting pilot (paid) for customers who need fine-tuning — helps monetize and buys us time to build.

Priya (Eng): From a risk perspective, promising fine-tuning will blow up support surface. +1 to deferring.

Maya (PM): Great. Success criteria (proposal):
- 8 active orgs completing >75% onboarding checklist within 2 weeks of start
- median 95th-percentile latency within target SLO for 90% of requests
- 3 teams report a measurable improvement in task completion (self-reported + example transcripts)
- feedback loop: average NPS >= 7 at week 6

Theo (SE): Can we be more concrete on "onboarding checklist" items? Suggest: infra sanity, test eval run, sample integration, 1 production route.

Maya (PM): Yes. I'll add a checklist doc to the onboarding repo.

Jon (GTM): Outreach phrasing for invite (first cut):
```text
Subject: Invitation: Redwood Private Preview — limited spots
Hi <Name>,
We are running a small private preview focused on production inference (latency, cost, reliability). We'll provide dedicated onboarding support and early access to batching/caching controls. Would you be open to a 30-min intro this week?
```

Ana (Solutions): Minor edit: call out "data residency & KMS support" for regulated sectors.

Maya (PM): Noted. I'll update. Also: timeline — goal to start invites next Monday, onboarding week after. Any blockers?

Priya (Eng): Need confirmation on paired SE headcount for onboarding. I can allocate 0.5 FTE for the 8-week pilot (shared across cohorts).

Theo (SE): I can support the technical onboarding sessions — will need calendar invites from Jon once we have participants.

Jon (GTM): I'll run the outreach and track responses in the cohort sheet. Shortlist target: 30 invites -> 12 accepts -> 8 starters.

Maya (PM): Risk register quick notes:
- Scope creep (requests for fine-tuning / eval dashboards) -> mitigation: explicit "out of scope" doc and paid consulting option
- Onboarding delays -> mitigation: pre-flight checklist + mandatory eval run before session
- Privacy concerns -> mitigation: clear telemetry policy + KMS options

Ana (Solutions): Also include a simple SLA/expectations doc for response time during pilot. Helps manage expectations.

Maya (PM): Action items: 
- Jon: outreach copy + cohort sheet by EOD (ASAP)
- Priya: add eval CLI and telemetry opt-out notes to repo by Thu
- Theo: onboarding session template + checklist by Thu
- Ana: draft pilot SLA and privacy blurb by Fri
- Maya: final criteria and invite list by Fri noon

invite-bot: Scheduled reminder set for 1767777900 (ping #product)

Jon (GTM): On it. Will ping when draft is live.

Priya (Eng): Working on the CLI now.

Maya (PM): Thanks team :thumbsup: We can reconvene after outreach responses start rolling in.

Theo (SE): :rocket:
